Swagger UI (interface documentation)    Apache License 2.0
WinFsp (the drive), installed by the    GNU General Public License 3.0, with the
installer of Pseudalis when missing     FLOSS exception of its author

WinFsp - Windows File System Proxy, Copyright (C) Bill Zissimopoulos
https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp

Pseudalis carries the installer of WinFsp unchanged, and its service loads the
library WinFsp installs.  WinFsp stays installed when Pseudalis is uninstalled.

The texts of these licenses are installed with Pseudalis, in licenses\, and the
license of Swagger UI in web\docs.

Detection models
----------------

The models that find the personal data (the tagger and the span model of the
example slm_document_anonymizer_ex of Dlib-Transformer-extensions) are compiled
into the engines of Pseudalis and distributed under the Boost Software License
1.0 with them.

The protection is a pseudonymization in the sense of the GDPR: the key of this
computer restores the data, which stay personal data for its holder.  Reading a
protected document again before sharing it remains recommended.
